title: SATA-BENCH: SELECT ALL THAT APPLY BENCH MARK FOR MULTIPLE CHOICE QUESTIONS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the systematic tendency of models to favor or avoid specific answer choices or positions regardless of content, measured using Selection Probability Divergence (SPD), Standard Deviation of Recalls (RStd), and Relative Standard Deviation (RSD).

Measuring the tendency of models to systematically underpredict or mispredict the total number of correct answers, evaluated using mean signed difference (CtDif), mean absolute difference (CtDifAbs), and exact count match accuracy (CtAcc).
Quantifying the tendency of models to include incorrect options when uncertain rather than abstaining, measured via False Positive Rate (FPR) and Jaccard Index (JI).
